description: Hide or show one part, the same working-copy change as the Parts list visibility toggle. part_id is an opaque id: this does not accept a vault path and does not fall back to the active part. This is not agent_set_visible, which toggles operator-visible cues (the synthetic cursor, highlights, and pacing). Working copy only: it does not write git or the vault. Takes return: "status" | "summary" | "full" (MCP default "status": status.script is omitted; "summary" adds status.features; "full" echoes the script).

part_id.description: Opaque part id from parts. Not a vault path. Does not fall back to the active part.

return.description: How much of status to return: "status" drops status.script, "summary" drops it and adds status.features (the feature strip), "full" keeps the whole script. Over MCP the default is "status"; in the page it is "full". Read the script with get_script.

visible.description: true shows the part, false hides it.

name: set_part_visible
